Experience creating data-rich, complex, or high-stakes interfaces for demanding professional users. Ability to communicate credibly with domain experts and translate complex workflows into clear, effective product experiences. Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, performance, and cross-device behaviour. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary product squad alongside software engineers and other stakeholders. Candidates may come from design, engineering, or multidisciplinary backgrounds; the key requirement is the ability to design, build, and ship high-quality products. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8d4a9882-2e16-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Austria. This role offers the opportunity to shape how sensitive data is stored, accessed, and protected across a complex enterprise environment. You will assess data sensitivity, system usage, workflows, and storage practices across multiple business areas. A key focus will be identifying high-risk use cases and determining where VDI, stronger access controls, or other secure solutions can provide the best protection. You will translate detailed analysis into practical recommendations, business cases, and migration roadmaps. Working closely with Security, Technology, and business stakeholders, you will help align solutions with data protection and governance requirements. The role combines business analysis, data security, infrastructure, and stakeholder management in a highly collaborative environment. Your work will directly support stronger data protection, informed technology decisions, and sustainable security practices. Partner with business groups across the organization to inventory systems, tools, endpoints, and data usage patterns associated with physical device storage. Assess and classify data sensitivity across business units, systems, processes, and workflows, identifying areas of heightened security risk. Analyze data and process flows across systems, servers, networks, and endpoints to support risk assessments and migration planning. Identify critical systems and high-risk data storage practices that should be prioritized for migration to VDI or other secure data management solutions. Document current-state and proposed future-state data storage, access, and usage models. Evaluate viable solutions, including VDI, enhanced access controls, and other secure data management approaches, and recommend the most appropriate option for each use case. Develop business cases and recommendations for VDI migration, considering risk, cost, operational impact, and user adoption. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements-gathering sessions across departments. Collaborate with Security, Technology, and business teams to validate findings and ensure recommendations align with applicable data policies. Present analysis, findings, and recommendations clearly to technology leadership and other key stakeholders. Support the development of a migration roadmap, including dependencies, priorities, adoption, and change management considerations. Contribute to the design and documentation of privileged access management (PAM) processes and frameworks as part of broader data security initiatives. Support the development of auditing and compliance review processes covering data usage, access controls, and end-to-end data security. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 5–7+ years of professional Business Analyst experience, ideally with a strong background in data governance, data classification or sensitivity assessments, secure data storage, or IT infrastructure and endpoint initiatives. Demonstrated experience working in complex, multi-platform, enterprise-level environments and analyzing systems usage and data flows across multiple business units. Familiarity with VDI concepts and platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop, or a proven ability to quickly understand and work within new technical domains. Strong experience conducting stakeholder interviews, facilitating requirements-gathering sessions, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. Ability to develop use cases, cost-benefit analyses, business cases, and executive-ready documentation. We often celebrate the final moment: a patient receiving a life-saving therapy or a groundbreaking treatment becoming standard of care. But behind that moment is a complex, coordinated effort that begins years earlier. Pharmaceutical and med device companies shoulder this responsibility every day: - Advancing science from lab to clinic - Navigating regulatory and access barriers - Ensuring safe, evidence-based adoption in the real world They’re not just bringing products to market; they’re shaping the future of care. Yet these organizations are often held back by outdated workflows and siloed data, unable to fully harness the knowledge that already exists across their teams. Atrix was built to change that.
